tool.name: LogRatioTransform
tool.summary: Log-ratio transform of compositional data (Aitchison 1986): the centred (CLR) or isometric (ILR, pivot coordinates; Egozcue et al. 2003) log-ratios of every band of a multi-band raster, so that high-count units do not dominate a later PCA or ICA.
tool.usage:
CLR gives one band per input band (they sum to zero); ILR gives one band fewer.

Values of 0 or less are replaced by half the smallest positive value of their band.

param.name: in_raster
param.dialogReference: Multi-band raster, such as K, eU, eTh.
param.pythonReference: Multi-band raster, such as K, eU, eTh.
